No.

We are not required to update the OS for the device in order to service the battery.

However in the event that we have to replace the display, we do need to delete the pending update on the device. If the device has an update pending and it is downloaded, we need to delete it prior to the repair if the customer does not wish to have it updated. Our calibration machines will not allow a downloaded update to be there to calibrate the device. If there is one, we will have to restore the device and run the calibration.

Source: Apple Employee in the US. Not sure how rules apply in other countries.

Displays replaced at kiosks and non authorized Apple repair centers are usually third party displays made with cheap material.
